I'm pulling the consolidated QBR packet together for next week's leadership sync. Need a short pass from each of you on the account rollup (see attachment) by end of day Tuesday so I can finalize the executive one-pager. High level asks below — please reply inline where possible:

- Flag any deals that require SLA/contract exceptions or credits.
- State the play: close, risk-mitigate, or reforecast (one-line).
- Attach (or link) any customer MOPs / mutual action plans we should surface.

Thanks,

Thanks for the fast turn. I reviewed the rollup and merged Karthik's notes into the executive sheet. Quick synthesis and next steps for leadership packet:

1) Runway highlights (for slide 1):
   - Total commit delta since last sprint: +$12k (net new upsells offset by one churned micro-account).
   - At-risk priority: Acme (contracts/legal), ZenCloud (procurement).

2) Asks for leadership (to include in the deck):
   - Legal: review Acme MOP/data-residency clause and provide approval or redline by Apr 5.
   - Sales leadership: confirm whether to offer a one-time 10% credit on Acme to secure signature by Apr 9.
   - Product: confirm QPS SLA for Northwell by Apr 6 or we drop into reforecast.

3) Account-specific bullets (one-liners to show on the appendix):
   - Acme: Contracting, legal gating; recommended action = exec legal escalation + credit approval option.
   - ZenCloud: Procurement SOC2 ask; provide crosswalk + 30-day pilot.
   - Northwell Health: Usage spike; product to confirm QPS SLA.

I've uploaded the compiled deck draft and the one-pager to the shared sheet (link above). Laura — can you sanity-check the Northwell velocity numbers? Tessa — confirm if you want me to include an executive escalation note for Acme's CISO. Karthik — confirm the exact credit wording you'd prefer in the mutual action plan.

I'll send the leadership packet to Aditya and Markus after we close these bullets (target Wed 7am PT). Thanks for the quick turn — will call out final deck changes in the sheet.
